rows.name: New Mexico Medical Board
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines New Mexico's physicians and physician assistants. Nine members appointed by the Governor — six physicians, a physician assistant, and two public members (NMSA 61-6-2).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the New Mexico Statutes; NM publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: New Mexico Board of Nursing
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates New Mexico's nurses. Seven members appointed by the Governor — four licensed nurses and three public members (NMSA 61-3-8).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the New Mexico Statutes; NM publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: New Mexico State Game Commission
rows.mandate: Sets policy and regulations for the New Mexico Department of Game and Fish. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — district and at-large seats, no more than four from one party (NMSA 17-1-2).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the New Mexico Statutes; NM publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: New Mexico Real Estate Commission
rows.constituent: New Mexico home buyers & licensed brokers
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates New Mexico's real estate brokers. Five members appointed by the Governor — four brokers and one public member, no more than one per county (NMSA 61-29-4).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the New Mexico Statutes; NM publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
